notes.title: Update Post-Launch v1.2 - Roll On Dice
notes.content:
Hello to everyone, 

During the weekend, an issue with display at a refresh rate of 30Hz and below was found. 
Indeed, it provoked an issue where the Player Dice broke whereas it should have beaten the opponent Dice. 
[b]Today, this issue is fixed now in the new live 1.2 Update of Roll On Dice![/b]

Have fun,

Thank you,
Stephane
(Edalbung)

notes.title: Update Post-Launch v1.1 & Patch Notes - Roll On Dice
notes.content:
Hello to everyone, 

I'm glad to announce that [b][u]the first update post-launch patch v1.1 of Roll On Dice is live now![/u][/b]

Here is the patch notes:
[list]
[*] Added 8 Achievements (visible in Achievements list) 
--> A quick note: If you have already finished the game, for the Fifth and Last World achievement you will need to finish the last level one more time in order to unlock it
[*] Steam Cloud integration
[*] Fixed UI issues (cut logo and titles) with 21:9 format
[*] Fixed UI possible overlap in Menus
[*] Fixed a misleading Level Design I - 7 level
[*] Added a Restart action in game, where you can now directly restart a level by simply maintaining R key (Keyboard) / Right Shoulder button (Gamepad - example RB on a Xbox Controller)
--> Adding this new action to "Controls" submenu for information
[/list]

Have fun,

Thank you,
Stephane
(Edalbung)
